description: Defines a class 'multi_vendor::tlvf_handler' for managing vendor-specific TLV handlers, including registration and execution mechanisms, with detailed comments on design and usage.

classes.name: multi_vendor::tlvf_handler
classes.description: Manages registration and execution of vendor-specific TLV handlers for IEEE 1905.1 messages.

methods.name: register_handler
methods.description: Registers a handler function for a specific IEEE 1905.1 message type.

methods.name: add_vs_tlv
methods.description: Executes all registered handlers for a given message type, appending vendor-specific TLVs.

methods.name: to_index
methods.description: Converts a message type to an internal index; returns -1 if unknown.
